name: @sauce/zk
description: SauceScript's ZK-coprocessor requests: a query about a chain's history now, and the `.then` body run on the same Private Pot when the proven results are called back. `Zk.axiom(query)` sends an Axiom V2 query whose callback carries the body as its extra data; `axiomV2Callback` is the body of the handler the Pot answers AxiomV2Query's callback with, which checks the caller and the query's sender before it runs the body. Built on @sauce/async. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (zk.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the coprocessors' contracts are EVM contracts.
